title: SAT Math Adaptive Calibration Learning Report & Learner Model Update (Session f54585d8-b881-433e-ab98-c6a4d24be003)
executiveSummary:
During the period 2026-08-06T21:20:00.060Z to 2026-08-06T21:25:35.734Z (Session f54585d8-b881-433e-ab98-c6a4d24be003), the learner completed a 15-item adaptive Math calibration set at Difficulty Level 2. All skills evaluated in this single session are maintained as tentative mastery assessments pending multi-item and multi-session verification.
